note: Settlement broken down by asset rather than rolled up per anchor. An anchor can be busy in one asset and silent in another, and a single per-anchor verdict hides that — a payment agent routing naira should not be reassured by euro traffic.
limits: Counts, volumes and counterparty spread are measured. Per-asset liveness is INFERRED from the account carrying the asset, because the scan timestamps last activity per account rather than per asset. Every liveness object says so in its `basis` field. Measuring it properly is a change to the indexer, not to this artifact.
